source_text: Τοιγαροῦν οὐδὲ τὸ ἔλαιον ἀργῶς ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον ἐπέχεε τῆς στήλης· ἀλλὰ τοῦτο μὲν ἐκείνου δηλωτικὸν ἦν οὗ διεπράττετο σπουδαίως ἡ Μαρία, μύρον ἐξ ἄκρων ἐπιχέουσα τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ ποσίν· αὐτὸ δὲ πάλιν ἐτύγχανεν ἐκεῖνο μήνυμα τῆς ταφῆς, ὡς αὐτὸς ἐσαφήνισεν ἀναφανδὸν ὁ Κύριος· ὁ δὲ λίθος οὗτος εἰκονίζει τὸν ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἐκεῖνον λίθον, ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν μὲν οἰ οἰκοδομοῦντες, εἰς γωνίας δὲ κεφαλὴν ἐγένετο. 8 ∆ύο ἔθνη καὶ δύο λαοὺς αἱ θεῖαι δηλοῦσι γραφαί. Καὶ τούτου μάρτυς Μωϋσῆς· ἐν τῇ κοσμοποιΐᾳ γοῦν τὸν τῆς Ῥεβέκκας διηγούμενος βίον, λέγει μὲν ὅπως ἐπορεύθη πυθέσθαι παρὰ Κυρίου περὶ ὧν εἶχε συλλαβοῦσα.
thought_title: The oil and the stone as signs of Christ's anointing, burial, and cornerstone
orientation: Eustathius is explaining the prophetic meaning of the details of Jacob's pillar at Bethel, now turning to the oil poured on it and the stone itself.
pass_a_gloss: Therefore not even the oil did he pour idly upon the top of the pillar; but this was indicative of that which Mary was doing earnestly, pouring ointment from her jar upon the feet of Christ; and this again happened to be that sign of the burial, as the Lord himself made clear openly; and this stone images that cornerstone which the builders rejected, but which became the cornerstone. The divine scriptures indicate two nations and two peoples. And of this Moses is witness; in Genesis at any rate, narrating the life of Rebecca, he says how she went to inquire of the Lord concerning what she had conceived.

pass_b_english: So he did not pour the oil on the top of the pillar without purpose. Rather, it pointed to what Mary was doing earnestly when she poured ointment upon the extremities, the feet of Christ. And that oil, in turn, happened to be a sign of the burial, as the Lord himself made clear openly. This stone images that cornerstone which the builders rejected, but which became the cornerstone (Psalm 117:22). The divine Scriptures reveal two nations and two peoples. Moses is a witness to this. In Genesis, when he narrates the life of Rebecca, he says that she went to inquire of the Lord about what she had conceived.
